title:
Comment of Jessica Hubbard in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/19/2026

documents.name: 151668.txt
documents.text:
Jessica Hubbard, Davenport, IA.
The Bay of Fundy is a delicate and important ecosystem especially for right whales and the remaining 331 endangered Cook inlet belugas. Recent studies have shown that noise emitted from data centers has been shown to be disruptive and harmful to animals and humans alike. I implore you to refrain from allowing this data center to built. We are rapidly losing what little habitat is left for these creatures. And as humans we are part of these habitats and will also be negatively impacted if we continue to alter them.
